cards.review_notes: Verify dates, address, and registration destination directly with the church. Official Facebook and MyAnswers pages could not be read. Dates and address were found in https://www.findglocal.com/US/Marion/939428689260906/VBS-Grace-Baptist-Church, which mirrors a May 14, 2026 post saying June 14–19. The mirror also links the MyAnswers page and a Google pre-registration form. A third-party event listing gives a June 14 start at 5:30 PM, but hours were left null because official confirmation was unavailable. The ages 4–13 in an older official Facebook search result were not reused for 2026.
